Using the Receipt Quality History Insight Screen

children: Using the Receipt Quality History Insight Screen

You can use the Receipt Quality History Insight screen to search and manage receipt quality records in your warehouse. Any time you check in a license plate on a new receipt, close a receipt, or reopen a closed receipt, the system writes a quality record with reason code. Examples of receipt quality history reason codes are Items not received, Receipt received on time, and Missed expected receipt date.

Using the Quality History Insight Screen
Using the Receipt Line Insight Screen

The following is discussed in this topic:
You can use the Receipt Quality History Insight Screen to search for and view receipt quality records in your warehouse.
Open the Receipt Quality History Insight Screen.
Use the Basic Criteria Fields (located on the Filter Pane) to indicate the values for your primary search.
Press the Apply Filter Button. The system will display  the resulting records in the List Pane.
If you select one of the result records from the List Pane, then the system will display its information in the Detail Pane.
The Receipt Quality History Insight Screen's List Pane displays the results from a query performed in the Filter Pane.
For more general information about the List Pane, see the topic
The action accessible from the Receipt Quality History Insight screen:

This action allows you to view the receipt quality history records. When this action is selected, the system will open the Receipt Quality History  Details screen in view mode with the following fields: Receipt Info, Item Info, Reference Info, and User Defined. For more information on these fields, see the topic
